scope: read-only state inspection plus force-stop of an already-open diagnostic probe to release the camera
notes: The probe had left iris camera ID 2 open despite the earlier no-client readback.
The force-stop released its camera session; subsequent dumpsys reports the active-client list empty and all three camera devices closed.
The phone remains covered by a reflective can, so no camera stream or IR emitter test was run.
Device-reported wall clock and host UTC disagree; the host timestamp is retained for ordering and the device time is recorded verbatim.
